note: Hand-derived from CodeInterprocEvidenceUpsertCypher (go/internal/storage/cypher/edge/writer/code_interproc_evidence.go): `UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (s:Function {uid: row.source_function_uid}) MATCH (t:Function {uid: row.sink_function_uid}) MERGE (s)-[rel:TAINT_FLOWS_TO {evidence_uid: row.uid}]->(t) SET ...`, NOT from the port or family name. TAINT_FLOWS_TO is the only type this writer can emit (static token in the template, kept out of any per-row substitution). Each endpoint is the Function uid the collector resolved; the identity pin is the row uid taint.codeInterprocEvidenceUID derives as facts.StableID over source_function_uid, sink_function_uid, sink_kind, and source_kind (the MERGE keys on endpoints plus evidence_uid, so the fixture declares exactly that identity -- any other identity shape fails LoadExpectedEdges against the family's registration). Exactly two edges: the credential to payment-capture flow from authenticate to chargeCard, and the http-request to search-exec flow from parseQuery to runQuery (the cloud-boundary finding carrying the two-step why-trail). The tombstoned legacy finding contributes nothing on purpose -- the extractor skips tombstones before decoding, so a deleted flow reaches neither the rows nor the quarantine count. sink_kind and source_kind ride as Properties pins (the template SETs them as plain strings from the row); scope_id, generation_id, and evidence_source are writer-stamped per run and cannot be pinned statically.
